lines.text: Why can a detour through another phone beat the direct path?
Radio signals weaken quickly with distance.
Cut each hop in half, and the signal arrives about four times stronger.
A weak link drops packets, so each one is sent again and again.
Two strong hops need fewer sends in total.
But a relay also takes airtime, so a decent direct link still wins.
Download Meshline for private nearby messages, even offline.
